001: Ivan, have you already received confirmation for the business trip to Saint Petersburg?
Yes, Anna, everything is still on. The trip is from next Monday through Thursday.
Great. You will need to prepare a presentation for the meeting with the partners.
I have already started working on it. I just need to add a few slides with our new indicators.
Good. Also, don't forget to book the hotel and the train tickets.
Yes, I will take care of that this evening. Thanks for reminding me.
002: Sergey, what documents are needed for the business trip report?
Usually you need the tickets, the hotel bills, and the meeting agenda.
And if I am going for two days, do I need to get the plan approved in advance?
Yes, absolutely. The department head has to sign the plan before the departure.
Understood. Then I will prepare the plan and show it at the meeting tomorrow.
Great. If you have any questions, I will help you with the paperwork.
003: Maria, you are flying to Novosibirsk on Friday, right?
Yes, the flight is at nine in the morning. I have already checked in online.
And what about the transfer from the airport to the office?
They told me that a driver from the partner company will pick us up.
That is convenient. Did you take all the necessary materials for the negotiations?
Yes, I put the laptop, the printed contracts, and the business cards in my bag.
004: Dmitry, do you have experience organizing a business trip abroad?
Yes, I went to Minsk last year. There were some specific details there.
Like what, for example? Do I need to get insurance arranged in advance?
Absolutely. And it is also better to make copies of all the documents and leave them at the office.
Good advice. And how did you handle the currency issue?
I exchanged the money in advance so I wouldn't waste time over there.
005: Anna, I am leaving for a business trip to Kazan next week.
Great, Ivan. Have you already made a list of goals for this trip?
Yes, the main tasks are signing the contract and inspecting the new warehouse.
Good. Don't forget to get the trip budget approved with the finance department.
I have already sent them the request. I am waiting for the confirmation by tomorrow.
Then everything is in order. Good luck with the negotiations!
006: Sergey, how long does it take to prepare for a business trip?
I usually start getting ready a week in advance so I can do everything calmly.
And what is the most difficult part of that process?
Probably coordinating the meetings and booking the conference rooms at the partners' offices.
I see. And how do you usually plan the route between the meetings?
I try to group the meetings by area to save time on travel.
007: Maria, have you already booked a hotel for the trip to Yekaterinburg?
Not yet, I am choosing between two options. One is closer to the office, the other is cheaper.
I would advise choosing the one that is closer so you don't waste time on commuting.
You are right, especially since we have a tight schedule of meetings.
By the way, don't forget to check if the hotel includes breakfast.
Yes, I have already checked. Breakfast is included in the price, which is convenient.
008: Dmitry, do you need any help preparing the report on the last business trip?
Thanks, Anna, but I am almost done. I just need to add the financial results.
Good. And have you already turned in all the checks and receipts to the accounting department?
Yes, I gave them yesterday. The accountant said everything is in order.
Great. Then all that's left is to get the report signed by the manager.
Yes, I made an appointment with him for tomorrow at eleven o'clock.
009: Ivan, what souvenirs do you usually take with you on a business trip for the partners?
I usually take small gifts with our company's branding.
That is a good idea. And how many gifts do you need to prepare?
I take extra, in case there are more meetings than planned.
Understood. And do they need to be wrapped in any special way?
It is preferable for the wrapping to look neat and professional.
010: Sergey, do you already know the schedule for your business trip to Sochi?
Yes, the meetings are set for Tuesday and Wednesday, and on Thursday I am coming back.
And do you have any time to see the city, or is it strictly a work visit?
Unfortunately, the schedule is very tight. I hope I will at least have time for dinner by the sea.
I understand. But the main thing is to conduct the negotiations successfully.
Agreed. And after I get back, I will immediately prepare a detailed report.
